name: moments_peek_edge
shows: peeking over a flat edge: head, leaves and two hands only, cut straight at the bottom (the sheet's edge line removed), curious and happy
caution: cut flat at the bottom on purpose: always place its bottom edge on a card's or the screen's edge, never floating

name: moments_gift
shows: holding out a yellow wrapped gift box with a red bow, smiling

name: moments_phone_up
shows: holding a phone up beside his head, looking at it, curious, gold lines (looking for signal)

name: moments_stamp_check
shows: pressing a rubber stamp onto paper that shows a green check mark, proud, gold lines

name: moments_clap
shows: clapping with hands at the cheeks, eyes shut happy, gold lines

name: moments_doorway_wave
shows: standing in an open brown doorway (dark inside), winking and waving
caution: the doorway's inside is a dark navy panel: on a dark card it reads as a hole, test on the dark theme
